name: bellis
description: Bellis Autonomous Live — 自主游戏直播系统

scripts.check: pnpm evidence:check && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm runtime:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:memory:iris: pnpm build && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris typecheck && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris test && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris build && node scripts/iris/iris-public-probe.mjs

scripts.test:memory:iris:tools: pnpm build && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris build && node scripts/iris/iris-public-probe.mjs --tools

scripts.test:memory:iris:continuous: pnpm build && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris build && node --test scripts/test/phase4-cycle-audit.test.mjs && node scripts/iris/iris-public-probe.mjs --continuous
scripts.test:memory:iris:recovery: pnpm build && pnpm --dir providers/memory-iris build && node scripts/iris/iris-public-probe.mjs --recovery
